about: The mutant ledger of runtime/v1/exec: edits of the leaf's source that its own tests must kill. Its rows moved from runtime/v1's ledger when BS8 moved the code into this leaf (re-anchored by wf10 EXPLORE-rt r3). Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./runtime/v1/exec (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger").

mutants.name: exec-env-inherits-host
mutants.rule: A program's environment is exactly its Command's Env: nothing of this process's environment reaches it (stdlib.md exec 1, law EnvIsExact).

mutants.name: exec-lookup-on-host-path
mutants.rule: A name with no slash is looked up on the PATH of the program's env, never on this process's (law LookupUsesChildPath).

mutants.name: exec-sandbox-env-fallback
mutants.rule: A program of the case's folder sees only the environment it is given, as the host's does, never this process's under it.

mutants.name: cu4c-drops-byte
mutants.rule: Chunks gives every byte a read returned.

mutants.name: g5-tostdout-own-pipe
mutants.from: w = outW // the very file standard output goes to
mutants.to: _ = outW; pr, pw, _ := os.Pipe(); reads[i], w = pr, pw; writes = append(writes, pw) // the very file standard output goes to
mutants.rule: A standard error of ToStdout writes to standard output's pipe or file, not a pipe of its own: its lines come unmarked and in the order written with standard output's.

mutants.name: g5-tostdout-discarded
mutants.from: w = outW // the very file standard output goes to
mutants.to: _ = outW; w = nil // the very file standard output goes to
mutants.rule: A standard error of ToStdout reaches standard output's sink, not the null device.

mutants.name: g5-spawn-tostdout-ignored
mutants.from: cmd.Stderr = cmd.Stdout // nil (the null device) or standard output's file
mutants.to: cmd.Stderr = nil // nil (the null device) or standard output's file
mutants.rule: A spawned program's standard error of ToStdout goes to standard output's file, in the order written.

mutants.name: g5-spawn-stdout-to-itself
mutants.rule: Spawn with a standard output of ToStdout is Failed.

mutants.name: cu4c-drops-final-newline
mutants.rule: Chunks keeps each line feed: x and x\n differ.

mutants.name: cu4c-adds-final-newline
mutants.rule: A stream's end is one empty chunk; no line feed is added to a last fragment.

mutants.name: cu4c-buffers-until-exit
mutants.rule: Chunks gives the bytes as each read returns them, not when a buffer fills or the program ends.

mutants.name: cu4c-stream-mixup
mutants.rule: Each chunk names the stream it came from.

mutants.name: cu4c-lines-drops-last-fragment
mutants.rule: Lines gives a last line with no line feed at its stream's end.

mutants.name: cu4c-break-loses-held
mutants.rule: A break of Lines puts back the bytes it read and did not give, for the next Lines or Chunks.

mutants.name: cu4c-stop-loses-held
mutants.rule: A stop of a Lines mid-read puts back the bytes it held, as a break does.

mutants.name: cu4c-skips-put-back
mutants.to: if c, ok := r.takeBack(); false && ok {
mutants.rule: The chunks put back come before any other.

mutants.name: cu4b-skips-reap
mutants.to:
func (r *Running) Stop(ct *rt.Task) int {
	v1.Release(ct, func() { r.end() })
mutants.rule: Stop reaps and closes its streams before it returns, even if the leader already exited.

mutants.name: cu4b-invented-status
mutants.rule: Stop returns the actual child's status, including a nonstandard TERM trap exit and an already exited program.

mutants.name: cu4b-skips-shutdown
mutants.rule: Stop before output or mid-stream ends and reaps the owned program before returning.

mutants.name: cu4b-checks-stopped-caller
mutants.rule: Stop completes owned cleanup and returns its status even for a caller with pending interruption.

mutants.name: cu4-no-term
mutants.rule: A release with a grace sends SIGTERM first and SIGKILL only after the grace.

mutants.name: cu4-no-kill-after-grace
mutants.rule: A program that outlives its grace (it ignores SIGTERM) gets SIGKILL; the release always ends it.

mutants.name: cu4-finish-keeps-lines
mutants.rule: Wait and the release drop the lines not read: Lines after them gives none.

mutants.name: cu4-stopped-lines-reads
mutants.rule: A stopped caller's Lines or Chunks ends with the stop and takes nothing (re-anchored by CU4c: both read through next).

mutants.name: cu4-no-group-wait
mutants.rule: The release returns only when no process of the program's group is left, zombies included.

mutants.name: cu4-start-ignores-stop
mutants.rule: A stopped caller's Start starts nothing and makes no file sink.

mutants.name: cu4-run-grace-ignored
mutants.rule: Run's stop follows the command's grace: SIGTERM first.

mutants.name: stz-waitfor-ended-status
mutants.rule: stdlib.md exec, WaitFor: an ended program gives Wait's status.

mutants.name: stz-waitfor-ends-the-program
mutants.rule: stdlib.md exec, WaitFor: the deadline first fails Expired and leaves the program running, unsignalled, with its unread bytes.

mutants.name: stz-waitfor-arms-ended
mutants.rule: stdlib.md exec, WaitFor: a program that has ended gives its status at once and arms no deadline.

mutants.name: stz-waitfor-ignores-stop
mutants.from: return v1.After(span, t, s, nil, d,
mutants.to: return v1.After(span, rt.Root("detached"), s, nil, d,
mutants.rule: stdlib.md exec, WaitFor: a stop of the caller ends the wait, as Wait's.

mutants.name: sb8-no-flush-start
mutants.from: v1.FlushStdout() // the child starts after what was printed (stdlib.md io 11)
mutants.rule: stdlib.md io 10: exec.Start's child starts after what was printed.

mutants.name: spawn-no-setsid
mutants.rule: Spawn starts the program in a session and process group of its own, which Kill signals.

mutants.name: alive-ignores-start
mutants.to: return err == nil && (n == start || n != start)
mutants.rule: Alive and Kill act only on the process whose start time is the Detached's, never on a pid another process reused.

mutants.name: kill-no-sigkill
mutants.rule: Kill sends SIGKILL after the grace, to the group and to the program itself, so a group that ignores SIGTERM ends.

mutants.name: spawn-tocaller-admitted
mutants.rule: A detached program's ToCaller sink is Failed: no caller outlives it to read it.

mutants.name: darwin-start-zero
mutants.rule: Darwin's start time of a process is read from its kinfo_proc and is not 0, so Alive and Kill tell a reused pid apart.
mutants.gap: killed only on darwin: the Linux run builds exec_spawn_linux.go; the Mac bulk check runs it (mac-bulk-pending.txt)

mutants.name: linux-start-zero
mutants.rule: Linux's start time of a process is read from /proc/<pid>/stat and is not 0.

mutants.name: spawn-stopped-starts
mutants.rule: A stopped caller's Spawn starts nothing and raises the stop.

mutants.name: kill-stop-waits-grace
mutants.rule: A stop of Kill's caller during the grace ends the wait and goes on to SIGKILL.

mutants.name: th1b-start-unsandboxed
mutants.rule: A command of the test's folder that Start starts is in the folder's sandbox on Linux.

mutants.name: th1b-run-unsandboxed
mutants.rule: A command of the test's folder that Run runs is in the folder's sandbox on Linux (rows.md, Test's ambient 5; TH1b).

mutants.name: th1c-helper-per-command
mutants.rule: The commands of one case's folder share one helper: one re-exec of the binary per case, not per command (TH1c).

mutants.name: th1c-helper-kept
mutants.rule: The case's end ends and reaps its helper.

mutants.name: th1c-fork-not-parent
mutants.rule: The helper forks each program as a child of the test process, so Run's stop protocol waits for and reaps its own child.

mutants.name: th1c-helper-dumpable
mutants.rule: A program of the case cannot reach its helper (not dumpable).

mutants.name: th1c-no-access-check
mutants.rule: The helper refuses a program that cannot run before its fork, so no failed child is left unreaped.

mutants.name: th1b-caps-kept
mutants.rule: The program runs with no capability, so it cannot undo the sandbox.

mutants.name: th1b-writable
mutants.from: if err := sbMountSetattr(root, 0, sbMountAttr{clr: sbMountAttrReadOnly}); err != nil {
mutants.rule: In the sandbox the folder stays writable.

mutants.name: th1-exec-sink
mutants.rule: exec.NewTestHost refuses a file sink out of the folder.

mutants.name: th1-exec-args
mutants.rule: exec.NewTestHost refuses an argument that leads out of the folder.
